newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Norilsk Nickel gets new deputy director.
newsitem.headline: Russian Norilsk Nickel gets new deputy director.

text.p: Russia's RAO Norilsk Nickel metals group named Yuri Kotlyar as first deputy general director, Interfax news agency said Monday.
It said Kotlyar would be responsible for strategic development at the company, including social issues and matters connected with precious metals.
RAO Norilsky Nikel is Russia's largest producer of nickel and copper and a major world supplier of platinum, palladium and platinum group metals.
Kotlyar was acting general director of the State Committee for Precious Metals and Stones, or Komdragmet, before it was disbanded in December 1996.
His appointment is the latest change to the leadership at the financially troubled Norilsk group, which is heavily indebted to the Russian government and to its workers.
